import numpy as np, json
def comps(g,val):
    g=np.array(g); seen=np.zeros_like(g,bool); res=[]
    for i,j in zip(*np.where(g==val)):
        if seen[i,j]: continue
        st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=1; c=[]
        while st:
            x,y=st.pop(); c.append((int(x),int(y)))
            for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                a,b=x+dx,y+dy
                if 0<=a<g.shape[0] and 0<=b<g.shape[1] and g[a,b]==val and not seen[a,b]:
                    seen[a,b]=1; st.append((a,b))
        res.append(c)
    return res
def f(g):
    g=np.array(g); vals,counts=sorted(set(g.flatten()), key=lambda v:-np.sum(g==v))
    # minority color = least frequent
    val=vals[np.argmin(np.bincount(g.flatten()))]
    cs=comps(g,val)
    ranks={len(c):k for k,c in enumerate(sorted(cs,key=len),1)}
    out=g.copy()
    for c,k in ranks.items(): out[c[:,0],c[:,1]]=k
    return [[int(x) for x in r] for r in out]
